name: Harvest Festival
lore: The road rolls into a cozy autumn fair: smiling pumpkins, friendly little ghosts, owls and black cats, kids in costumes, apples, pies and a big harvest feast, with sunflowers and hay bales all along the way.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's Harvest Festival (cute Halloween, never scary, and Thanksgiving; close portraits on plain backgrounds and simple scenes, Peter's 10/13 framing rule), 43 picks and 12 spares after lane D's readability pre-read (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/12-harvest-festival/README.md, picks-full.json, workspace 931393c: 5 swaps from the spares, 3 dropped, then 2 of the swaps, hf037b Pumpkin stack and hf039 Corn kid, dropped too; round 2, workspace ee1b129, after critic-land-12: hf012b Dragon costume (maroon eyes, M1) and hf057 Feast table (the weak Hard, M2) dropped); lane C edited many of them (a tighter crop, the plain background split into a sky band and a ground band; the edit field, ops in edits.json; the file <id>e.png). Kind painting, shade on, converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The 55 manifest lines are lane C's, whole; lane D filled only the empty url with the licence row's source in Dino Valley's words. The folder keeps lane C's slug (12); as installed it is Land 9 in the factory's numbering (era 17) and Zen World 10.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (tools/map-plan-v7.md section 2; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots, each repeat its own pair (45 levels on 5 sheets: sheet 12 three times, sheet 21 twice, the plan's lists trimmed to the repeats laid). Kinds for an autumn fair: mushrooms, a woodpile (a bonfire), a raven, an owl, a wisp (a ghost light) and glowcaps.

zen.note: v7 lane D: Harvest Festival plays as Zen World 10 (tools/land.js ... zen writes tools/build-data/levels/zen.json only). Records keep the land factory numbers 543-585 (scratch/state.json seeded {from: 543, sheet0: 73, gal0: 62}: Worlds 1-9 hold 1-50, 201-250, 251-300, 301-350, 351-400, 401-429, 430-479, 480-492, 493-542; World 9's 7 sheets end at 72); the page shows them on from World 9's last Zen number (Zen 393-435, main.js zenNum); zen.numbered keys each licence row by its Zen picture number before its level.

profile.note: Zen World 10, casual (v7 lane D, 2026-10-13): Dino Valley's profile as it ships, as Worlds 7 Under the Sea and 9 Puppy Park (tools/lands/11-puppy-park/land.json; AI pictures): tags E18/N26/H6/X0 at 50 (E15/N23/H5 at this world's 43) ending on a Hard, ? cards, linked squads, gentle moats (2 ways in) on pictures that can carry and deal one, no locks, no archers, no Extreme, no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08), careful floor 0.5 every tag, deal attempts 96 at the land-config squads.

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

mainNote: Lane C's order (picks-full.json landMain, workspace ee1b129: 43 after the pre-read's 5 swaps and 5 drops and the critic's 2 drops).

map.note: v7 lever 1: no new image bytes. tools/map-plan-v7.md section 2: the castle sheets 12 (castle towers among trees and fields: the cozy manor) and 21 (a dense forest whose glowing spots turn into warm lantern lights) reused through map.fromLayout, alternately mirrored, under one pumpkin-orange tint, warmer and redder than World 5's varnish (sepia .95: at .45 sheet 21 stays green). Sheet 12's river turns a dark amber-brown autumn stream under its plank bridge.
